## Verdict
The computer is not healthy; a critical crash occurred.

## Needs attention
- **Process crash.** A system process died unexpectedly, which can cause instability or data loss. **Fix:** Restart the computer to see if the process recovers or if the issue persists.
- **Wi-Fi status.** The Wi-Fi firmware loaded successfully, so the logs do not prove a Wi-Fi failure. **Fix:** Check if Wi-Fi works in your settings; if it is down, try toggling it off and on.

## Fine to ignore
- **Firmware load.** The Wi-Fi firmware loaded successfully, which is a good sign. **Why it is harmless:** This confirms the hardware driver loaded correctly, even though another process crashed.
